d:
Sahar Yousef, scientist at UC Berkeley, reveals why your phone makes you dumber even when switched off
She explains:
• Why your phone measurably reduces your cognitive capacity even when it is switched off and face down
• How to rewire your identity and beliefs using neuroscience backed techniques not willpower
• What happens when you multitask and why your brain is physically incapable of doing two things at once
• How to improve focus and productivity at work
• Why vague goals fail and how if-then plans and tiny habits create lasting behavioural change
